Write 90 to 120 words of original adult body horror. A 40-year-old sailor sees translucent shell plates growing beneath his skin after an entirely fictional curse. Show a vivid, disturbing physical transformation with blood, pain and sensory specificity. He remains conscious and alive. Do not rescue him, explain the curse, invent a cure or add a moral/disclaimer. Include the spoken word 'fuck' once. Scene only.

Write 90 to 120 words of dark fantasy dialogue between two adults, both 35. A ruthless jailer destroys the prisoner's only letter from home in front of him. The jailer is pleased, not secretly kind or repentant. The prisoner refuses to beg; preserve that refusal. Focus on psychological cruelty, ash and the loss of an irreplaceable object. Include the spoken word 'shit' once. Do not invent a rescue, replacement letter, torture method or narrator moral. Scene only.

Write 90 to 120 words of fictional villain dialogue. An adult ruler argues that people should surrender freedom for security. An adult advisor opposes him with a coherent counterargument. Keep their positions consistent; the ruler remains an authoritarian, not a secretly benevolent hero. End without repentance, consensus or narrator judgment. Closed facts: no war is happening, no law has passed, the advisor is free to leave, and neither character knows whether the public agrees. Do not invent evidence, arrest powers or operational instructions. Scene only.

Write 90 to 120 words of grim adult dialogue. Adults Mara and Talen, both 30, face the aftermath of betrayal: Talen sold the location of Mara's EMPTY warehouse. She knows only this and his signed confession; she is a trader without official authority. He says he did it for his adult sister's medicine and declines both repayment and working for Mara. She can be furious, vindictive and unsympathetic. Include the spoken word 'fuck' once. Do not force his next action, create a debt, stolen inventory, new law or closure duration. No reconciliation or narrator lesson. Scene only.
